definitionZh: 将样式从比例(自然宽度,默认宽度)调整为 Monospace(固定宽度)。 使用比例间距,每个glyph在一条线上占据一个独特的空间,而单空间是所有glyphs的字符总宽度相同的时候.
sourceDefinition: Adjust the style from Proportional (natural widths, default) to Monospace (fixed width). With proportional spacing, each glyph takes up a unique amount of space on a line, while monospace is when all glyphs have the same total character width.
